question: Do they use number of votes as an indicator of preference?
title: Disunited Nations? A Multiplex Network Approach to Detecting Preference Affinity Blocs using Texts and Votes
answer_rationale: The documents indicate that UN roll call votes are used as a source for deriving preferences, described as a 'valuable source of revealed preference information' (Text 1) and 'useful signals of different aspects of underlying state preferences' (Text 5). The use of votes alongside speeches is emphasized to better estimate preferences, suggesting votes serve as an indicator of preference.
